probes.title: Ending the matching provider session does not remove the notification overlay input
probes.limitations: Whole listener hook and reducer, exact remote callback and pure ring rule. React primitives, successful calls query and notification delivery are synthetic. No mounted overlay or audible ringtone; UI effect is verified statically against the retained input.

probes.title: The prior answer flag maps a new incoming call to the answered dialog without accepting it
probes.limitations: Exact answer callback, whole listener and exact visualStatus; the initialStatus literal is read from actual JSX. Preserved component instance and no explicit dialog-close action are scenario preconditions. Does not claim B was answered at the transport.

probes.title: Answer on a WhatsApp notification invokes the SIP session API without notification identity
probes.limitations: Exact alert/provider callbacks and capability functions; SIP boundary is a spy. Concurrent unrelated SIP ringing is an explicit scenario, not observed traffic. Independently, an idle SIP engine has no WhatsApp adapter dispatch or WhatsApp persistence through this path.

probes.title: Remote call update validates the watched ID but neither the live session ID nor the valid event for ringing
probes.limitations: Exact remote callback plus whole reducer. The positive control preserves the existing comparison against the subscribed ID. The cross-call scenario assumes the overlay is watching B while the provider owns A; only provider state, not SIP transport hangup, is demonstrated.

method: HEAD and all source blobs verified before parsing/evaluation. Exact AST callbacks, whole pure modules and whole listener hook; synthetic React state, query, notification and SIP boundaries. No browser rendering or provider acceptance.
